newsitem.title: USA: Unicom plans major non-nuclear announcement.
newsitem.headline: Unicom plans major non-nuclear announcement.

text.p: Unicom Inc, parent company of Commonwealth Edison Co, said Tuesday it will make a signficant, non-nuclear, announcement on Wednesday, August 6 at 1400 EDT in Chicago.
Unicom declined to provide any details about the nature of the announcement.

Several analysts speculated that Unicom might announce a strategic alliance with a gas marketer. Many power companies are seeking to broaden their competitive arsenal by merging or entering partnerships with gas companies, giving them greater access to cheaper fuel for power generation.

At the same time, access to more gas eases their reliance on coal and nuclear power, which carry potentially heavy environmental liabilities and, in the case of nuclear, is burdened with the high cost of strict safety regulations.

"Unicom has publicly indicated that it is searching for strategic alliance for a natural gas marketer to add gas to its energy marketing efforts," said Catharina Milostan, analyst at Mesirow Financial.
Shares of Unicom closed off 1/16 to 22-3/4.
